before.topology_source: Cached original OSM way node IDs in osm_full.json; inferred crossings are separately identified

after.limitation: DTM and schematic profiles do not establish engineered bridge clearance, indoor floor levels or tunnel depth. Layer-separated profiles remain topologically independent.

source_xy_preservation: All original source vertices are inserted without snapping; only interpolated points densify existing segments.
repair_policy: Connect original shared OSM node IDs including layer-changing approaches; do not snap distinct nearby nodes, close crop-boundary gaps, or connect grade-separated / access-restricted geometric crossings.
